summary: On August 28, 2026, CL Workshop Group Ltd's subsidiary Nature Flooring (Europe) Company Limited agreed to sell the entire issued share capital of Swift Top Capital Resources Limited to Mrs. Un Son I for US$1.00. The Disposal Group, engaged in log trading and IT/business consultancy, had net liabilities of ~$0.6M and losses of $0.2M (2025) and $1.5M (7M 2026). The board approved the disposal, citing a fairness opinion from an independent valuer valuing the equity at $(577,465), and believes terms are fair and reasonable. The transaction removes a loss-making unit, allowing focus on core wood products. Watch for completion and any regulatory approvals.
